# Shredded variant test files

Cases from Apache parquet-testing's `shredded_variant/` (commit bcefdfd),
generated by Apache Iceberg's `TestVariantReaders`, used by
`src/format/lake/variant_col.zig` to check reading shredded variants. Each
`case-NNN.parquet` holds rows of `id` and a variant column `var`;
`case-NNN_row-K.variant.bin` is row K's expected variant, its metadata followed
by its value. Copied unchanged; licensed under the Apache License 2.0.

| Case | Test |
|-|-|
| 018 | `testShreddedVariantPrimitives`: a date |
| 033 | `testShreddedVariantPrimitives`: a timestamp with nanoseconds |
| 044 | `testShreddedObjectWithinShreddedObject` |
| 126 | `testArrayWithNestedObject` (two rows) |
| 134 | `testPartiallyShreddedObject` |
| 040 | `testArrayWithElementValueTypedValueConflict`: invalid, must fail |
